KnightLoader checks Usenet downloads from your own servers with par2 and repairs what is missing.

## ✨ Added

- **par2 check and repair for your own Usenet servers.** Once every file of a release is here, KnightLoader checks it against the release's par2 files and rebuilds the blocks of missing articles. A release with gaps no longer has to go to a debrid account, and only as many recovery files are downloaded as the repair needs.
- **Files posted under a random name get their real name back** from the par2 set.
- **Verifying and Repairing show in the download list,** in the Android app and in Sonarr and Radarr. Nothing of the release is unpacked before it has passed.
- **A release that can't be repaired stops early.** When it has more damage than its recovery files can rebuild, it goes to your next account or fails as soon as that is certain, before the rest is downloaded.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new texts are in all 42 languages, in the web UI and the Android app.
